content.text:
Pinpoint HQ board listing was already in place; **JD fetch was still scraping the careers page**. That page is a JS app, so the stored text was chrome plus empty headings (`Key Responsibilities`, `Skills…`) and none of the real body.

Pinpoint’s `postings.json` already has the full ad in four fields: `description`, `key_responsibilities`, `skills_knowledge_expertise`, and `benefits`. Recruitee had the same split-field bug.

**What changed**
- `pinpointhq` now has a real JD fetcher that joins those JSON sections (and drops Pinpoint’s `<!--block-->` comments, which were showing up as the word “block” in the panel).
- It is registered in `_JOB_DETAIL_FETCHERS`, so panel/MCP fetch and the bulk refetch script use the API instead of HTML fallback.
- Junk locations like `Belgrade, /` are ignored.

Re-fetch the Tabby JD on the company workspace (Fetch job description). The copy already stored is the incomplete page scrape and will not update on its own.
